import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

producers = {
    'pharmacophoremt': Path('/home/diego/repos@uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/pharmacophoremt'),
    'molsysmt': Path('/tmp/phmt-ccd-provider-snapshot/molsysmt'),
    'pyunitwizard': Path('/home/diego/repos@uibcdf/pyunitwizard/pyunitwizard'),
    'ackredit': Path('/home/diego/repos@uibcdf/ackredit/ackredit'),
}

def snapshot():
    result = {}
    for name, root in producers.items():
        files = [(str(path.relative_to(root)), hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
                 for path in sorted(root.rglob('*.py'))]
        result[name] = {'path': str(root), 'python_file_count': len(files),
                       'python_source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(files, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()}
    return result

import molsysmt
assert Path(molsysmt.__file__).resolve().parent == producers['molsysmt']
before = snapshot()
manifest = json.loads(Path('/tmp/phmt-ccd-provider-snapshot/snapshot.json').read_text())
assert before['molsysmt']['python_source_sha256'] == manifest['python_source_sha256']
with Path('/tmp/phmt-curation-full.log').open('w') as log:
    completed = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '--receptor=llm',
                               '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '-p', 'no:rerunfailures', 'tests'], stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
after = snapshot()
report = {'schema': 'pharmacophoremt.curation_integration_audit@1',
          'executable': sys.executable, 'python': sys.version,
          'molsysmt_snapshot_manifest_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path('/tmp/phmt-ccd-provider-snapshot/snapshot.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'before': before, 'after': after, 'producer_sources_unchanged': before == after,
          'pytest_exit_code': completed.returncode}
Path('/tmp/phmt-curation-test-sources.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print('PASS' if before == after and completed.returncode == 0 else 'FAIL')
raise SystemExit(0 if before == after and completed.returncode == 0 else 1)
